session-memory.summary: short-lived conversational or working context with a TTL; rate limits and locks live here too

working-memory.summary: transactional state the agent must not lose — cursors, idempotency keys, approval status

episodic-memory.summary: structured history of what happened — decisions, extractions, transcripts

semantic-memory.summary: embeddings for retrieval over unstructured text

artifact-store.summary: documents, prompts, run logs and reports as objects, keyed by the idempotency key

cache.summary: hot data in front of a slower store; disposable

coordination.summary: leader election, distributed locks and configuration for a set of workloads

inference.summary: serves a model inside the cluster; zero egress

llm-gateway.summary: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of local and external models; routing, budgets, egress policy

chat-ui.summary: a human-facing chat surface over the gateway or an inference server

feedback.summary: captures what users think of an answer or an action, in product

message-broker.summary: decouples two workloads or fans out events; persistence and replay

mqtt-broker.summary: pub/sub for devices and sensors over MQTT

durable-workflows.summary: multi-step work that survives a pod dying halfway — retries, timers, human steps

cdc.summary: publishes a database's change log to a broker; the trigger is "a row changed"

document-parsing.summary: PDF and Office files to structured text with layout, tables and OCR

identity-provider.summary: who the user is, for oauth2-proxy in front of any HTTP surface

public-ingress.summary: reaches the internet without an open port, for webhooks and external users

low-code-automation.summary: visual flows for glue a developer should not have to write

secrets-mechanism.summary: how a secret gets from where it is kept into a workload; one per stage, ranked

secrets-store.summary: where secrets live, with audit, short-lived credentials and rotation

access-control.summary: service accounts and RBAC the workloads run under

gitops.summary: the cluster converges on what git says

block-storage.summary: replicated persistent volumes for stateful components

static-storage.summary: pre-provisioned volumes and claims for a lab cluster

metrics.summary: scrapes and stores time series; the source of metric gates

dashboards.summary: operational dashboards and alerting over the metrics store

telemetry.summary: collects logs and traces, including model and tool calls, and ships them

config-reload.summary: restarts consumers when a ConfigMap or Secret changes

cluster-ui.summary: a web view of the cluster for operators

image-registry.summary: stores the use case's images close to the cluster

backup.summary: scheduled backups and rehearsed restores of volumes and databases

cloud-resources.summary: provisions managed cloud services from Kubernetes objects

bi.summary: business dashboards over the system of record; evidence for KPI gates

smoke-test.summary: a workload that proves ingress, TLS and routing work

components.name: ai-models-litellm
components.notes: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of local and external models; routing, per-key spend, where egress policy is enforced. Provider API keys arrive as a Secret.

components.name: ai-models-ollama
components.notes: Zero-egress inference. CPU is fine for Crawl latency; a GPU node from Walk. Each model has its own licence.

components.name: ai-models-open-webui
components.notes: Fastest human-facing surface for a Crawl demo; speaks to LiteLLM or Ollama.

components.name: ai-models-vllm
components.notes: The production-shaped local inference server; concurrency and pinned model versions. Model licence separate.

components.name: analytics-metabase
components.summary: Metabase — open-source BI and analytics platform
components.notes: Reads the system of record; whoever sees a dashboard sees the rows behind it.

components.name: auth-gotrue-auth
components.summary: Gotrue Auth — Google OAuth authentication and authorization with per-app RBAC
components.notes: Pair with base oauth2-proxy for one login in front of any HTTP surface. Holds identities, so pii by nature.

components.name: brokers-mosquitto
components.notes: MQTT for devices and sensors; not a substitute for a message broker between workloads.

components.name: brokers-nats
components.summary: NATS 2.10 with JetStream — lightweight message streaming with persistence
components.notes: Lightweight (20 MB); JetStream gives persistence and replay. Default broker for event-driven use cases. Mounts `nats-secret`.

components.name: brokers-rabbitmq
components.summary: RabbitMQ 3.13 — AMQP broker with Streams support
components.notes: Classic work-queue semantics and AMQP; choose when AMQP clients already exist.

components.name: cdc-debezium-mariadb-nats
components.summary: Debezium Server — MariaDB Binlog → NATS JetStream CDC
components.notes: Source MariaDB (binlog), sink NATS.

components.name: cdc-debezium-mariadb-rabbitmq
components.summary: Debezium Server — MariaDB Binlog → RabbitMQ CDC
components.notes: Source MariaDB (binlog), sink RabbitMQ.

components.name: cdc-debezium-mongo-nats
components.summary: Debezium Server — MongoDB Change Streams → NATS JetStream CDC
components.notes: Source MongoDB (needs the replica set for the oplog), sink NATS.

components.name: cdc-debezium-mongo-rabbitmq
components.summary: Debezium Server — MongoDB Change Streams → RabbitMQ CDC
components.notes: Source MongoDB (needs the replica set for the oplog), sink RabbitMQ.

components.name: cdc-debezium-postgres-nats
components.summary: Debezium Server — PostgreSQL Logical Replication → NATS JetStream CDC
components.notes: Source Postgres (logical decoding), sink NATS. Doubles as an audit trail of row changes.

components.name: cdc-debezium-postgres-rabbitmq
components.summary: Debezium Server — PostgreSQL Logical Replication → RabbitMQ CDC
components.notes: Source Postgres (logical decoding), sink RabbitMQ.

components.name: cloudflare-tunnel
components.notes: Public ingress without open ports; two replicas. Traffic transits Cloudflare — a hop the compliance record names for residency and for health data.

components.name: communication-stalwart
components.summary: Stalwart Mail Server - SMTP/IMAP/JMAP mail & collaboration server

components.name: databases-etcd
components.notes: Dependency of Milvus; rarely chosen on its own.

components.name: databases-lancedb
components.notes: Embedded-style vector store served over HTTP; single writer, so concurrent ingestion is the limit. Cheapest semantic memory for Crawl.

components.name: databases-mariadb
components.notes: The relational alternative when a pack denies Postgres.

components.name: databases-milvus
components.notes: Heavier; needs etcd + MinIO. Reach for it when LanceDB's single-writer model is the bottleneck.

components.name: databases-mongodb
components.notes: Document-shaped chat state; SSPL is often disallowed in corporate packs. `mongodb/replica-set` adds the oplog CDC needs. Mounts `mongodb-secret`.

components.name: databases-mongodb-replica-set
components.summary: MongoDB replica set enabler — applied on top of databases/mongodb via components:

components.name: databases-postgres
components.notes: Default system of record. Single StatefulSet; move to an operator (CNPG) at Run for HA/PITR. Mounts `postgres-secret`.

components.name: databases-redis
components.notes: Short-term memory, rate limiting and locks; memory-bound, name the eviction policy. Check the image tag against the licence change.

components.name: docker-registry
components.notes: The local registry for k3d; GHCR or the organisation's registry from Walk.

components.name: document-processing-docling
components.notes: PDF/Office to structured text with tables, layout and OCR. Stateless CPU image; slow but dependable for Crawl.

components.name: iac-crossplane
components.summary: Crossplane: a Kubernetes-native control plane to declare cloud resources
components.notes: Cloud credentials arrive as a Secret; the resources it creates have their own classification.

components.name: minio-dev
components.notes: A bare Pod for k3d; dies with the environment.

components.name: minio-single-server
components.notes: A one-server Tenant through the operator in base; no redundancy. Run is the same Tenant with more servers, or an S3 service within residency. Buckets per kind (inbox, parsed, audit, seed).

components.name: monitoring-grafana
components.notes: Alertmanager rules live beside it; the three alerts that page are a Walk gate.

components.name: monitoring-kubernetes-dashboard
components.notes: Ingress, RBAC and token for the upstream dashboard; the dashboard itself is deployed by base or the tenant.

components.name: monitoring-otel-collector
components.notes: Agent DaemonSet plus a cluster Deployment; the step from metrics-only to metrics+logs+traces, needed for LLM call tracing. Logs can carry pii — scrub at the collector.

components.name: monitoring-reloader
components.summary: Stakater Reloader — auto-restarts Deployments/StatefulSets on Secret/ConfigMap changes

components.name: n8n
components.notes: Not OSI-approved; corporate packs often restrict it. Ships its own Postgres.

components.name: node-red
components.notes: Flows for devices and MQTT; pairs with mosquitto.

components.name: productivity-affine
components.summary: AFFiNE — open-source Notion + Miro alternative with built-in AI

components.name: sealed-secrets
components.notes: Encrypted SealedSecrets committed next to the overlay; the floor for secrets in git from Walk. The controller key is the single point of loss — its backup is a devops gate.

components.name: security-external-secrets
components.summary: External Secrets Operator (ESO) — syncs secrets from external stores
components.notes: Syncs from a store (openbao in the factory, or a corporate secret manager) into Kubernetes Secrets; rotation happens in the store. Not a store itself — pair it with a secrets-store.

components.name: security-openbao-eso-store
components.summary: OpenBao as an External Secrets store — applied on top of security/openbao via components:

components.name: security-openbao-follow-namespace
components.summary: transformer, not a component: makes security-openbao follow an overlay's namespace: (CRB subject, eso-store server)

components.name: security-openbao
components.summary: secret store (MPL-2.0, Vault API): raft, audit to stdout, kubernetes/approle/userpass auth and an SSH CA after bootstrap.sh
components.notes: The factory's secret store (Vault API, Linux Foundation); raft, audit, kubernetes/approle auth and an SSH CA after bootstrap.sh. `openbao/eso-store` is the ClusterSecretStore for external-secrets; `raft-snapshot` and `seal-static` are add-ons. Replaces the deprecated apps/security/vault.

components.name: security-openbao-raft-snapshot
components.summary: OpenBao raft snapshots — applied on top of security/openbao via components:

components.name: security-openbao-seal-static
components.summary: OpenBao static-key auto-unseal — applied on top of security/openbao via components:

components.name: security-vault
components.summary: deprecated in favour of security-openbao: `hashicorp/vault:1.19` (BUSL-1.1), file storage, no unseal story

components.name: storage-longhorn
components.notes: Not for k3d; single replica on a Pi, three replicas from Walk. Privileged by design — runs in its own namespace at its own PSA level.

components.name: surveys-formbricks
components.notes: In-product feedback capture for forjate:ux. Free-text answers are pii until proven otherwise.

components.name: workflows-temporal
components.notes: auto-setup image, server and UI; use bundles/temporal-stack for the Postgres wiring. Workflow payloads persist in its database.

components.name: bundles-temporal-stack
components.summary: temporal-stack — Temporal + PostgreSQL in a single reference
components.notes: Temporal plus its Postgres, wired. The default way to take durable-workflows.
